content.title: Market Movers: Is the dollar making a comeback?
content.description: The U.S. dollar has been on the rise this week and is trading around a two month high against a basket of major currencies. However, the greenback has been on the decline in 2025. So is this a sign it's making a comeback? ING's Francesco Pesole doesn't believe it is. For more live coverage of markets watch the full episode of Market Sunrise and head to Yahoo Finance.
